figurative_meaning_en: To go to ruin; to be destroyed or perish
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সব পরিকল্পনা গোল্লায় চলে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: All his plans have gone to ruin.
The crops will be destroyed in this rain.
note: The idiom draws from colloquial imagery of a 'godown' or storage as a place of neglect leading to decay, common in Bengali vernacular.
